# Paths whose changes can affect an existing publisher, app or operator config.
# One extended regex per line, matched against repo-relative paths. A PR that
# changes any of these must update docs/compat-log.md or say "Compat: none"
# (with a reason) in the PR body or a commit message. scripts/check-compat.sh.

# App contract: ring layout, record header, control events and protocol, SDK
^include/subplane/core/message\.h$
^include/subplane/shm/
^include/subplane/control/control_proto\.h$
^include/subplane/client/
^include/subplane/fanout/ring_writer\.h$

# Publisher contract: the canonical schema and generated views, the recap request
^schemas/subplane_canonical\.xml$
^tools/schema
^include/subplane/recap/

# The subplane protocol (SPP): schema, spec, generated codec
^schemas/subplane_proto\.xml$
^docs/protocol/
^include/subplane/proto/

# Config vocabulary: framing, decoders, partitions, sessions, transports, recap
^src/framing/
^include/subplane/framing/
^src/decoder/
^include/subplane/decoder/
^src/pipeline/partition\.cpp$
^src/pipeline/session\.cpp$
^src/transport/
^include/subplane/transport/
^src/registry/
^src/recap/
^config\.yaml$

# Operator surface: HTTP API, metric names and labels, the observability contract
^src/api_server\.cpp$
^src/agent\.cpp$
^src/metrics/
^docs/context/observability\.md$
